privacyAssessment.sensitivity: restricted: a SHA-256 of a bearer secret that grants read access to the owner's calendar feed; the plaintext is never stored
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: Follows the User row: erased with the account. The owner can revoke it at any time from the workspace calendar.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Credential hash on the account row; same access as the User row. No new personal content.

migration.name: 20261027170000_user_calendar_feed_token
migration.backfill: None. Every existing row gets NULL (no subscription link), which the feed treats as refuse. Verified against a throwaway postgres:16-alpine: empty table applied twice (idempotent), 500-row table applied with 0 hashes set, unique index enforced.
migration.rollback: Forward-only and additive. Older code never reads the columns; under older code the feed is id-only again, so do not roll back the route without the columns.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Existing model; the columns follow the account row.
